name: My PC Buddy
description: A little hiker who lives on your desktop: walks on the taskbar and your windows, reminds you of things (with snooze), chats with you like a friend, and lets you chat with your friends (on your phone too, with Pocket Buddy).

name: Pocket Buddy
description: My PC Buddy's Friends chat on your phone: the same account and chats as your PC, notifications you can reply to, ticks, emoji and PIN sign-in.
requirements: Android 8.0+; allow installing the .apk when asked

name: YT Grabber
description: Download YouTube videos in any quality (up to 4K) or as MP3, with an IDM-style download list (pause, resume, queue) and a Chrome/Edge button that sends the video you're watching.
